detail.longDescription: Ever heard of the reproducibility crisis? Did you spend the right amount of time designing your experiments statistically-wise? How can we make scientific studies more robust, trustworthy and efficient? Lamis Elkheir, from the African REproducibility Network, talked today about these issues and provided practical tools to overcome them.
